monthly.headline: Downturn: the squeeze, society under strain

tech_wave.advice: Sell picks and shovels: templates, courses and tools that help ordinary people use the new technology.

needs.name: Comfort and nostalgia
needs.feeling: Familiar, warm things for an uneasy time.
why: Trust and unrest, judgement (-2 to +2): -1 against a normal of 0 (worse than normal)
Consumer confidence (GfK): -22 against a normal of -11 (worse than normal, getting better)
House price to earnings (England): 7.6x against a normal of 6.5x (worse than normal, getting better)
needs.next_note: Tied to the social mood more than the economy, so it lasts while society stays under strain.
needs.weaken: these turn better for households: Trust and unrest, judgement (-2 to +2), Consumer confidence (GfK)

ideas.name: Heated throws and cosy-night bundles
ideas.test: One bundle, TikTok Shop and a gift-guide placement before Christmas

ideas.name: Retro and nostalgia merch for a specific decade or show (licensed or original)
ideas.test: Print-on-demand designs; spend nothing until something sells

call.question: Google searches in the UK for 'heated throw' and 'vinyl records' are higher in the 4 weeks to 27 February 2027 than in the same 4 weeks a year earlier

needs.name: Flexible spending
needs.feeling: Let people pause, shrink or spread costs instead of cancelling.
why: Direct Debit failure rate: 2.41% against a normal of 2.3% (worse than normal, getting worse)
Consumer confidence (GfK): -22 against a normal of -11 (worse than normal, getting better)
Bank Rate: 4% against a normal of 2.5% (worse than normal, getting worse)
needs.next_note: Likely to fade if the cycle turns to recovery, so keep stock and fixed costs light.
needs.weaken: these turn better for households: Direct Debit failure rate, Consumer confidence (GfK)

ideas.name: Refill and smaller-pack versions of an existing product
ideas.test: Offer the refill to current customers first

ideas.name: Pausable or skip-a-month subscription instead of a fixed one
ideas.test: Add a pause button and measure cancellations saved

call.question: Google searches in the UK for 'cancel subscription' and 'refill pouch' are higher in the 4 weeks to 27 February 2027 than in the same 4 weeks a year earlier

needs.name: Make do and mend
needs.feeling: Fix, cook and make at home to save money.
why: Inflation expected in a year (Bank of England): 5% against a normal of 2.5% (worse than normal)
Inflation now (CPI): 3.6% against a normal of 2.5% (worse than normal, getting worse)
Personal finances, next 12 months (GfK): -5 against a normal of 0 (worse than normal, getting worse)
Bank Rate: 4% against a normal of 2.5% (worse than normal, getting worse)
needs.next_note: Likely to fade if the cycle turns to recovery, so keep stock and fixed costs light.
needs.weaken: these turn better for households: Inflation expected in a year (Bank of England), Inflation now (CPI)

ideas.name: Air fryer and slow cooker batch-cook packs (recipes, shopping lists, tins)
ideas.test: Free sample week as a lead magnet; count email sign-ups

ideas.name: Draught-proofing and energy-saving home kit
ideas.test: Amazon or Etsy listing ahead of the cold snap; watch conversion

call.question: Google searches in the UK for 'air fryer recipes' and 'draught excluder' are higher in the 4 weeks to 27 February 2027 than in the same 4 weeks a year earlier

also.name: Renting and small-space living
also.feeling: Make a rented or shared home feel like yours without spending much.
why: House price to earnings (England): 7.6x against a normal of 6.5x (worse than normal, getting better)

also.name: Money control
also.feeling: Help people feel in charge of their money.
why: Direct Debit failure rate: 2.41% against a normal of 2.3% (worse than normal, getting worse)

also.name: Safety and self-reliance
also.feeling: Trust is low, so people want to feel prepared and protected.
why: Trust and unrest, judgement (-2 to +2): -1 against a normal of 0 (worse than normal)

also.name: Small rewards
also.feeling: Affordable treats that feel premium: the lipstick effect.
why: Consumer confidence (GfK): -22 against a normal of -11 (worse than normal, getting better)

scenarios.name: Frayed
scenarios.story: Sticky prices meet falling trust. Protest, polarisation and anxiety grow. People spend on safety, comfort and control.

scenarios.name: Grind
scenarios.story: Prices stay sticky and rates stay high, but society copes. A long, dull squeeze where value and small rewards win.
